description: Compare scuba courses, introductory dives, certified fun dives and snorkeling from independent dive centers on Be Underwater. Read published prices, inclusions and requirements, then check calendar availability for a date and group size. View the activity on Be Underwater for booking options. This plugin does not create reservations, process payments or provide medical assessments. Liveaboards are not included in this version.

review.commerce_description: Read-only information about in-person scuba and snorkeling activities. Links lead to activity information on Be Underwater. The integration does not create bookings, process payments, or sell digital content or subscriptions.

publication.release_notes: Expanded privacy policy identifying EJ Digital LLC and disclosing current tool inputs and outputs, processing purposes, recipients, request-limiting data, operational diagnostics, verified retention criteria, and user controls. No changes to the three read-only tools.
